label: Flowers
description: Named flowers, orchid and tulip forms, wildflowers, and flowering shrubs and trees, described in bloom.
notes: Named blossoms and visibly different flower forms belong here, including flowering trees when their blooms are the subject. plant.tree holds whole-tree identity and silhouette, and plant.houseplant holds plants chosen chiefly as indoor specimens. Values are plural or mass flower names that read before in bloom, without implying a bouquet or cut stems. Synonyms such as plumeria and frangipani share one entry; kind chips overlap where a flower is both a garden plant and a familiar cut flower.
